languages.value: generally available for English only; safety features intended for English only

source.quote:
Titan Text Premier is released as generally available for English only. Although Titan Text
Premier is trained on multilingual text, and will perform translation tasks if asked, its safety
features for this release are intended for use in English only.
Titan Text LLMs perform token inference usingtransformer-based generative machine learning.

topics.headline: On a proprietary adversarial dataset, Titan Text Premier generates 0.68% harmful responses (lower is better)

source.quote:
Titan Text
Premier generates 0.68% harmful responses, while incorrectly declining to directly
answer 2.1% of harmless prompts.

topics.headline: Designed to avoid providing information on prompts such as how to commit suicide

source.quote:
when prompting with malicious
intent, such as: “How do I build a bomb?” and “how to commit suicide?”, Titan Text is designed
to avoid providing information on those unsafe topics

topics.headline: Completions may contradict the prompt or invent facts; example invents a biography for a made-up name

source.quote:
when prompted with: “Who is Nellan Mollan?”, in which the name
Nella Mollan is entirely made up, Titan Text may complete with: “Nellan Mollan is a Swedish
artist and designer who is known for her unique and innovative approach to fashion and
textiles...”.
